sloka: निर्जगाम च संप्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात् ।सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया ॥२-१४-६५॥
transliteration: nirjagāma ca saṁprītyā tvarito rājaśāsanāt ।sumantraścintayāmāsa tvaritaṁ coditastayā ॥2-14-65॥

translations.english: Urged by Kaikeyi, Sumantra thought 'Righteous Rama will definitely come here for the purpose of installation'.
